CI run 41181594591, job tests-heal-plan-and-validation, fails with AssertionError: 3 != 2 at tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py:223. CI run 41181594591, job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, fails at tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:7831, and main() aborts at the first failure so later tests are masked. scripts/review_rb_judge.sh has the existing sites at line ~2422 and ~2515, and the helper's auto/direct calls at lines ~2318 and ~2320.
